meta.title: Dialog ledger
meta.description: Records every AI–human dialog turn into a local ledger (JSONL entries, verbatim originals, weekly Excel workbooks). Ships 3 read-only agent tools and 7 read-only panel APIs; zero dependencies, offline, no model calls, no context injection; the default ledger root is the desktop folder "会话账本". This is a lite-line snapshot, not the production-admission release.
